title: RuleGuard Read-Only Validator
description: 建立 upstream RuleGuard read-only deterministic gate，先以 deterministic 掃描檢查工具鏈是否仍停留在讀檔 / read-only child process，避免 task card / lock / shard / doc registry / lifecycle status mutation path 漏進來。
acceptance: RuleGuardAdapter 必須維持 read-only child process 與讀檔檢查，不能直接碰 task card / lock / shard / doc registry / lifecycle status mutation path
rule-pack.json 必須新增 `rule-guard-read-only`，並掛進 ATM profile，輸出 machine-readable findings
deterministic validator 必須輸出 `trigger / scope / severity / action / routeClass / routeHint` 等欄位
read-only gate 的結果要能穩定重跑，且不依賴手動判讀
